'''Star Tours Flight 526''' was the designation of a [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency flight to [[Garos IV]] and [[Ralltiir/Legends|Ralltiir]]. On the morning of the [[Raid at Spaceport THX1138]], it was set to arrive at Gate 2F at 0950 hours but it was delayed. Its departure was originally set to 1045 hours, but was changed to 1115 after the delay.
